To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we develop an accuracy model and data prediction model which are adaptive to the environment changes.
we have proposed two new models ADA and STDP to reduce communication overhead under data accuracy and data reduction strategies respectively.

We develop an accuracy model for wireless sensor networks using Steepest Descend method which doesn't require a priori information about input signal statistics to choose an optimal set of sensors to transmit data to the base station.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of adaptive strategies for data reduction in wireless sensor networks.
the development of an adaptive and distributed approach for sensor data reduction in WSNs which can be used to improve network performance and to detect malicious nodes.
the design of an efficient data collection mechanism to reduce the communication cost and energy consumption in WSNs under extreme physical environment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the ADA model can be used to estimate a desired data accuracy in wireless sensor networks, the STDP model can be used in wireless sensor network to capture the spatio-temporal correlation of sensing data for data reduction, and the STDP model is used to trace the malicious node under extreme physical environment.
, ADA model can be used to select a set of sensor nodes to achieve desired data accuracy and STDP model can be used for data reduction strategies in wireless sensor networks.
, the proposed adaptive strategies can be used to select an optimal subset of sensor nodes in WSNs to achieve the desired data accuracy and to reduce the communication cost.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed models can be used for data accuracy and prediction in wireless sensor networks.
we develop a new model for sensor data reduction and data prediction in wireless sensor networks.

, we propose an adaptive data accuracy model which doesn't need any a priori knowledge about the input statistics and also a spatio-temporal data prediction model which reduces communication overhead under extreme physical environment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed models are adaptive in nature and can be applied in any wireless sensor network.

the adaptive data accuracy and spatio-temporal data prediction models are very effective in reducing the energy consumption of the sensor nodes and also reducing the communication overhead of the network.
the proposed ADA model is more accurate and robust compared to existing models in terms of data accuracy.
